meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用脚本控制浏览器,导航网页、填表、点击、截图、抓取数据或测试网站;页面状态在多次脚本执行之间保留,可以小步执行、看结果再决定下一步。
howto.when: 当用户要求访问网站、填表、截图或其他浏览器自动化操作时接管,常用触发语是 “go to [url]” 这类说法。

say.text: 打开 example.com,告诉我页面标题和网址
say.note: 新建页面,访问后返回标题与 URL

say.text: 在 checkout 页面上点提交按钮,然后截图
say.note: 在已命名的页面上点击并截图保存

say.text: 连接我现有的 Chrome,登录后帮我填表提交
say.note: 需先以扩展模式启动中继服务

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a browser with scripts to navigate sites, fill forms, click, take screenshots, extract data or test web apps. Page state persists across script runs, so it can work in small steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data or otherwise automate browser workflows, including phrases like “go to [url]” or “click on”.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title and URL
say_en.note: Creates a page, returns title and URL

say_en.text: On the checkout page, click the submit button and screenshot
say_en.note: Clicks on an existing named page

say_en.text: Connect to my existing Chrome, log in, then fill the form
